source_text: Vestes scissae, caput nudum, extra castra. Luctus peccati. Extra ecclesiae pacem qui immundus perseverat.
pass_a_gloss: Garments torn, head bare, outside camp. Mourning of-sin. Outside of-church peace who unclean perseveres.
pass_b_english: [[Torn clothes, bare head, outside the camp >> Bible:Leviticus 13:45-46]] — sin’s mourning. Who stays unclean remains outside the church’s peace.
